name: Hoshi no Sasayaki
source:
Yutaka Inoue is a 3rd grade high school student attending Astronomy club. He goes on a trip with his best friends in hope of reinvigorating the sealed corners of his childhood memory.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
井上丰是一名高中三年级学生，也是天文社成员。他与挚友们一同出游，希望唤醒童年记忆中那些尘封的角落。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
